sources.handling: Independent task-bounded conceptual adaptation into existing canonical policies, engineering_workflow, universal final-change review guidance and the bounded completion lifecycle. No pstack source, prompts, scripts, package, roles or automation are installed or executed.
sources.inspection_scope: All 57 top-level skill bodies and 23 playbooks were fetched at the pin and inspected for declared scope, routing and steps; selected_files identifies the substantive sections reviewed for adaptation. Both agents and the three nested Benny skill scopes were separately inspected. This is source research, not observed upstream runtime behavior.

skills.handling: Ground behavior and constraints; choose a canonical data and ownership shape before consequential implementation. Alternative sketches are proportional to unresolved design risk.
Compare genuinely competing designs with a declared rubric and isolated outputs only when the task warrants alternatives; final choice requires direct validation.
Explicit, repeated user preferences may inform authorized canonical evolution. No transcript sweep, personal skill creation or host configuration is installed.
When making measured performance claims, verify completed work, correct output, error counts, comparable conditions, noise and end-to-end relevance; retain inconclusive results.
Trace load-bearing safety claims through real callers, wire/data/config/generated contracts and asynchronous ordering; prove relevant risks with actual execution when available.
Use readable user-language explanations without imposing a persona or fixed format.
For repeated demonstrated mistakes, prefer canonical ownership, schemas/types, actionable lint or behavior checks over duplicate instructions.
For consequential modeled boundaries, reuse or explicitly authorize suitable bounded verification, code correspondence and failing counterexamples; model proof is limited by its assumptions.
Discover existing launch/drive/observe/cleanup entry points; prove the real surface and retain evidence. New project-local harnesses are justified by actual gaps, not automatic skill generation.
Set a checkable outcome, scale rigor to risk, and iterate hypotheses using existing state and evidence rather than a second workflow store.
Ground ownership, data flow, runtime behavior, consumers and invariants in task-scoped source before changing them.
Resolve actual intent and acceptance from the user and project evidence; restatement is needed only when it changes an implementation decision.
Review the affected final change against intent, synthesize evidence-based findings and disagreements, and retain lead responsibility for disposition and follow-up.
Report current progress, evidence, unresolved decisions and next action from existing canonical state; avoid a new status ledger.
When covered code changes, inspect model-to-code correspondence and bounds before rerunning; distinguish model drift, real invariant failure and unavailable proof.
Keep affected verification recipes and maps aligned with actual behavior; exercise changed harness paths and distinguish doc drift, harness gaps and product defects.
Grok Bot webhooks, sender keys, Tailscale hosting and bot wake flows are not UPG dependencies or implicit authorization.
Review misleading or obsolete scoped comments, retaining legal, safety and contract context. Reject delete-on-ambiguity, comment personas and forced code reshapes.
Use existing UPG navigation; importing pstack command routing or a second help system would duplicate canonical guidance.
Adapt the intent/ground/design/implement/clean/review/prove/finish sequence into existing compiled governance. Exclude host roles, model defaults, rigid ceremony and ungranted autonomy.
When repeated fixes fail under one assumption, test that assumption directly before repeating it; discard changes whose hypothesis is refuted.
Place validation at actual trust boundaries and preserve internal invariants; do not remove defensive checks merely because they are repeated.
Reuse or add a rerunnable check or transformation when it reduces repeatable work or proves a meaningful claim; no tool-building quota.
Encode recurring demonstrated constraints at their canonical enforcement layer; keep judgment guidance only where structural enforcement is insufficient.
Explore alternatives when consequential uncertainty remains; no mandatory candidate count, paid model fan-out or prototype for settled local work.
Judge outcomes against actual user-visible needs and agreed contracts; implementation convenience does not define acceptance.
Tie measured claims to actual work, units, context and limiting factors, with unknown or inconclusive results preserved.
Trace confirmed symptoms to the responsible contract or invariant; legitimate boundary guards stay legitimate and scope remains bounded.
Choose state, data shape and ownership before scattering control flow; integrate at the smallest responsible canonical layer.
Use task-scoped indexes and concise delegated evidence without treating a summary or read budget as proof of coverage.
Minimize unnecessary work and indirection while completing all affected contracts, consumers and obligations; shortest diff is not the objective.
Check repeated execution and interruption recovery against observed state; recognize stale residue and reconcile partial operations.
Migrate affected callers and retire obsolete paths when safe, preserving external contracts and explicit compatibility obligations.
Prefer direct ownership and discoverable contracts over needless wrappers, hidden state or duplicated policy.
Use an appropriate canonical model, state machine, table or collection when it removes repeated shape assumptions and invalid states.
Proceed on already authorized reversible work; retain actual user approval gates, permission boundaries and preference decisions.
Define the target and cutover condition and finish migration obligations instead of preserving throwaway parallel truths.
Inspect current real artifacts and behavior before completion; timestamps, compile success and delegated self-reports do not prove the claim.
Integrate new requirements at the responsible layer; redesign wording does not authorize unrelated architecture changes.
Give independent actors disjoint owned writes; when a canonical shared object is required, enforce one-writer or locking/atomic behavior structurally.
Sequence dependent work into meaningful validated units and validate after affected changes; no commit-per-step requirement.
Remove proven obsolete in-scope paths when safe; retain required compatibility, historical evidence and retention obligations.
Use checks that fail on broken observable behavior and survive harmless internal changes; no implementation-mirroring test quota.
Encode valid states and parse external input at boundaries when supported by the actual language and contracts.
Recover task-relevant history and verify surfaced live state; no broad private transcript harvesting or invented prior intent.
Only explicitly authorized governance evolution may adapt durable lessons through canonical source, regeneration, checks and audit; no live installed-skill mutation.
Do not import model-role settings, .cursor rules, plugin setup or global host configuration.
Clarify the actual outcome, primary evidence and objective acceptance without enlarging the authorized task.
Keep factual decisions and reusable evidence in existing current state and bounded handoff; do not add a second TSV/history ledger.
When existing models or a consequential state-machine task warrant it, map states and counterexamples to code and replay them against real behavior; no Mermaid/TLA runtime import.
Declare coverage and done criteria, isolate independent writes, account for delegated outcomes and verify their artifacts; respect actual host capacity and cost limits.
For a practical regression path, observe failing-before then passing-after behavior; use the closest meaningful executable check when a new test is unjustified.
Explain only decision-relevant behavior and rationale from source; no mandatory diagrams, image generation or full multi-source sweep.
Maintain readable task-relevant documentation with exact technical payload and evidence limits; no universal editorial taxonomy or punctuation rules.
Language-specific guidance is routed only when actual TypeScript work needs it; UPG does not install a universal TypeScript layer.
Remove empty phrasing while preserving contracts, uncertainty and exact payload; no mechanical vocabulary ban, punctuation ban or detector goal.
Distinguish explicit rationale, supported inference, hypotheses and unknowns; search relevant authorized sources without mandatory unrelated connector sweeps.

playbooks.handling: For explicitly authorized skill evolution, edit canonical source and verify generated package metadata, references, behavior and installation.
Use a checkable exit condition and bounded evidence-led iterations within current authorization; no persistent loop, automatic schedule, side-scope fixes or relaxed acceptance.
Retain current-revision independent verification and owner accounting as review concepts. Do not import cloud owners, automatic merge or a standing program.
Dependency ordering and single topology ownership inform review when a real stack exists; no implicit branch rewrite, retarget, push or merge authority.
When explicitly requested, reconcile actual PR state and evidence, classify failures before retrying and review bot findings on their merits; no automatic monitor.
Reproduce the relevant symptom, discriminate root-cause hypotheses, implement the scoped cause and repeat the same meaningful path after the fix.
For authorized evaluations, freeze question and evidence identities and retain failures, cost and uncertainty; no paid trial or promotion from development-only proof.
Ground affected behavior, model state/ownership, order dependent steps, delegate independent scopes proportionally and prove actual acceptance.
Only an authorized measured optimization task uses a bounded hypothesis loop with valid baseline, errors/work counts and keep-or-revert evidence; no unbounded or paid search.
A read-only request produces a cited explanation or judgment; it does not mutate maintained state or require a PR.
For an actual planning deliverable, record dependencies, owned outputs, acceptance and unresolved gates in existing project form; reject fixed templates and ten verification lanes.
When delivery requires a PR, provide concrete intent, change, risks and current validation; no universal ready-PR, stack, reset-hard or rebasing policy.
Retain bounded owner/accountability and prerequisite ordering concepts in existing workflow state; do not install orch runtime, multi-day coordinator or parallel ledger.
On an explicit pause, leave factual resumable current state and stop owned work safely; no automatic WIP commit, push or temporary-only canonical handoff.
Use comparable real workload baseline and post-change evidence and diagnose the limiter before claiming improvement.
For consequential empirical uncertainty, isolate the smallest experiment and label its observed scope and throwaway status; do not treat prototype evidence as release proof.
Pin affected behavior, move in verifiable steps, trace string/docs/generated consumers and prove equivalence before retiring obsolete paths.
When live diagnosis is authorized, bind instrumented observations to actual process and source, with permissions and side effects explicit; no unrequested live hotfix.
Reuse still-current verified evidence and reconstruct observable state; prior transcripts and self-reports remain input and never override current code or validation.
Before authorized delivery, revalidate that the review covers current affected bytes and actual target context; confirm actual remote result. No automatic landing or patch-id-as-proof shortcut.
Interpret supplied capture and source mappings without inventing causality; retain strongest-hypothesis status when no paired or live confirmation exists.
When visual equivalence is the actual acceptance, preserve a meaningful baseline and compare relevant states on the real surface; do not alter the baseline merely to pass.
Verify actual ownership, active use, dirty/untracked/ignored content and recoverability before authorized cleanup; reject force removal, transcript-wide sweeps and system cache cleanup.

agents.handling: Delegate explicit scope and current instructions using observed host capabilities; the lead independently checks artifacts. Do not import role discovery, highest-version selection or background defaults.

mappings.trigger: An authorized implementation changes a shared mechanism, caller contract, dependency or structural boundary.
mappings.adapted_capability: Solve the complete scoped problem at the responsible canonical layer, reuse existing facilities, reach affected callers/tests/config and remove superseded local paths safely. Correctness and completion take precedence over line count.
exclusions: shortest diff/fewest lines as an objective
a local wrapper used instead of the shared cause
unrelated architecture redesign
dropping error handling, security, accessibility or user-requested behavior

acceptance.fixture: A shared defect has two callers; a one-line caller patch hides it while a bounded canonical fix requires both callers and an affected contract check.
pass_if: the responsible shared mechanism and affected consumers are covered
existing infrastructure is reused and replaced local paths are reviewed
unrelated behavior and user changes remain preserved
fail_if: the smaller diff wins despite an unresolved caller
a new dependency or abstraction is added without task need

defer work merely to minimize the diff

pass_if: the fixable scoped defect is fixed
the blocked item has a bounded risk/mitigation/review record
claims remain limited to inspected scope
fail_if: the comment alone excuses a currently unsafe shortcut
a local scan asserts project-wide debt clearance

mappings.adapted_capability: Use existing launch/drive/observe/cleanup paths and real current artifacts; capture action and resulting state, keep evidence after owned cleanup, distinguish doc/harness/model drift from real defects, preserve model bounds and counterexamples, and validate that measured work completed correctly under comparable conditions.

mandatory live/performance/full-feature checks for every local edit
weakened properties, altered baselines, mocked proxy checks or no-op/error timing presented as success

performance claims retain work/error counts, comparable scope, limits and inconclusive status; cleanup preserves evidence and owns only its processes

a model pass is reported as whole-system proof or an unknown benchmark is a measured gain
